newsitem.title: MOZAMBIQUE: New Mozambican insurance company inaugurated.
newsitem.headline: New Mozambican insurance company inaugurated.

text.p: A new private insurance company, Mozambique International Insurance (SIM), has been set up in Maputo, the Mozambique News Agency said on Saturday.
The inauguration coincided with the first anniversary of the creation of the International Bank of Mozambique (BIM), which is the major shareholder in SIM, with 50.1 per cent of the share capital.
BIM's chairman is Mario Machungo, who was prime minister under the late Mozambican president Samora Machel.
The other major shareholder is a consortium of Portuguese banks and insurance companies, with 39.9 per cent.

Mozambique's publicly-owned telecommunications company, TDM, holds five per cent of SIM and the remaining five per cent is owned by the Community Development Foundation, a Mozambican non-governmental organisation chaired by Graca Machel, widow of Samora Machel.
